say.en: Your kidneys filter about 180 litres of fluid every day, more than a big water drum, yet you pass only about one and a half litres of urine. Where does the rest go? In this lesson: Name the three processes of urine formation.
Describe the filtration membrane.
Calculate the GFR per day and the percentage reabsorbed.

body.en: Urine formation involves *glomerular filtration*, reabsorption and secretion, in different parts of the nephron. On average 1100–1200 mL of blood is filtered by the kidneys per minute, about one-fifth of the blood pumped out by each ventricle. Glomerular capillary blood pressure filters blood through three layers: the endothelium of the glomerular blood vessels, the epithelium of Bowman's capsule and a basement membrane between them. The epithelial cells of Bowman's capsule, called podocytes, leave minute spaces called filtration slits. Almost all plasma constituents except the proteins pass into Bowman's capsule, so this is ultrafiltration.
body.kn: ಮೂತ್ರ ರಚನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಗ್ಲಾಮೆರುಲರ್ ಸೋಸುವಿಕೆ, ಮರುಹೀರಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ರವಿಸುವಿಕೆ ಎಂಬ ಮೂರು ಹಂತಗಳಿವೆ. ಮೂರು ಪದರಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ರಕ್ತ ಸೋಸಲ್ಪಡುತ್ತದೆ; ಪೊಡೋಸೈಟ್‌ಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಸೋಸುವ ಸೀಳುಗಳಿವೆ. ಪ್ರೋಟೀನ್ ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಉಳಿದೆಲ್ಲಾ ಘಟಕಗಳು ಸೋಸಲ್ಪಡುವುದರಿಂದ ಇದು ಅತಿಸೋಸುವಿಕೆ.

say.en: Urine is made in three steps: filtration at the glomerulus, reabsorption from the tubule into the blood, and secretion from the blood into the tubule.
The filter has three layers. Podocytes leave tiny filtration slits, so everything except proteins passes: this is ultrafiltration.
Now the numbers. The kidneys make about 125 millilitres of filtrate a minute.
GFR is kept steady by the juxtaglomerular apparatus. If GFR falls, JG cells release renin, glomerular blood flow rises and GFR returns to normal.

caption.en: The glomeruli filter about 125 mL of blood plasma a minute, about 180 L a day, but about 99% of the filtrate is reabsorbed, so only about 1.5 L of urine is made. If blood pressure and GFR fall, juxtaglomerular cells release renin, which brings the GFR back to normal.

body.en: The amount of filtrate formed by the kidneys per minute is the glomerular filtration rate (GFR), about 125 mL per minute in a healthy person, that is, 180 litres per day. The juxtaglomerular apparatus (JGA), a special sensitive region formed by a cellular modification in the DCT and the afferent arteriole where they contact, regulates GFR: a fall in GFR makes the JG cells release renin, which raises glomerular blood flow and brings GFR back to normal. Since only about 1.5 litres of *urine* is released a day, nearly 99 per cent of the filtrate is reabsorbed by the renal tubules — actively for glucose, amino acids and Na+, and passively for nitrogenous wastes and water.
body.kn: ಒಂದು ನಿಮಿಷದಲ್ಲಿ ರೂಪುಗೊಳ್ಳುವ ಸೋಸಿದ ದ್ರವವೇ GFR, ಸುಮಾರು 125 ಮಿ.ಲೀ/ನಿಮಿಷ ಅಂದರೆ ದಿನಕ್ಕೆ 180 ಲೀಟರ್. ಜಕ್ಸ್ಟಾಗ್ಲಾಮೆರುಲರ್ ಉಪಕರಣ GFR ಅನ್ನು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಸುಮಾರು 99% ಸೋಸಿದ ದ್ರವ ಮರುಹೀರಲ್ಪಡುತ್ತದೆ.

problem.en: A healthy person has a GFR of 125 mL per minute and passes 1.5 L of urine a day. Find the volume filtered per day, the volume reabsorbed, and the percentage reabsorbed.

steps.en: Filtrate per day = 125 mL × 1440 = 1,80,000 mL = 180 L.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. A healthy person has a GFR of 125 mL per minute and passes 1.5 L of urine a day. Find the volume filtered per day, the volume reabsorbed, and the percentage reabsorbed.

say.en: Let us work this out together. A healthy person has a GFR of 125 millilitres per minute and passes 1.5 L of urine a day. Find the volume filtered per day, the volume reabsorbed, and the percentage reabsorbed.
Minutes in a day equals 24 times 60 equals 1440.
Filtrate per day equals 125 millilitres times 1440 equals 1,80,000 millilitres equals 180 L.
Reabsorbed equals 180 minus 1.5 equals 178.5 L.
Percentage reabsorbed equals 178.5 divided by 180 times 100 is approximately 99.2 per cent.
So the answer is 180 L filtered, 178.5 L about 99 percent reabsorbed.

homework.en: Why is the afferent arteriole wider than the efferent arteriole? Explain in two lines.

narration.en: Recap. Urine forms by glomerular filtration, reabsorption and secretion. The filtration membrane has three layers; podocytes leave filtration slits. GFR is about 125 mL per minute, 180 L per day. About 99% of the filtrate is reabsorbed; the JGA keeps GFR steady.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಮೂತ್ರ ಗ್ಲಾಮೆರುಲರ್ ಸೋಸುವಿಕೆ, ಮರುಹೀರಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ರವಿಸುವಿಕೆಯಿಂದ ರೂಪುಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ. ಸೋಸುವ ಪೊರೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮೂರು ಪದರಗಳಿವೆ; ಪೊಡೋಸೈಟ್‌ಗಳು ಸೋಸುವ ಸೀಳುಗಳನ್ನು ಬಿಡುತ್ತವೆ. GFR ಸುಮಾರು 125 ಮಿ.ಲೀ/ನಿಮಿಷ, ದಿನಕ್ಕೆ 180 ಲೀಟರ್. ಸುಮಾರು 99% ಸೋಸಿದ ದ್ರವ ಮರುಹೀರಲ್ಪಡುತ್ತದೆ; JGA, GFR ಅನ್ನು ಸ್ಥಿರವಾಗಿಡುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: Let us recall the key ideas. Urine forms by glomerular filtration, reabsorption and secretion.
say.kn: ಮುಖ್ಯ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ನೆನಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋಣ. ಮೂತ್ರ ಗ್ಲಾಮೆರುಲರ್ ಸೋಸುವಿಕೆ, ಮರುಹೀರಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ರವಿಸುವಿಕೆಯಿಂದ ರೂಪುಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: The filtration membrane has three layers; podocytes leave filtration slits.
say.kn: ಸೋಸುವ ಪೊರೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮೂರು ಪದರಗಳಿವೆ; ಪೊಡೋಸೈಟ್‌ಗಳು ಸೋಸುವ ಸೀಳುಗಳನ್ನು ಬಿಡುತ್ತವೆ.

say.en: GFR is about 125 millilitres per minute, 180 L per day.
About 99 percent of the filtrate is reabsorbed; the JGA keeps GFR steady.
say.kn: ಸುಮಾರು 99 percent ಸೋಸಿದ ದ್ರವ ಮರುಹೀರಲ್ಪಡುತ್ತದೆ; JGA, GFR ಅನ್ನು ಸ್ಥಿರವಾಗಿಡುತ್ತದೆ.
